title: finding(spec): `FieldSchema`'s "SNAKE_CASE TOLERANCE" docblock and three `liveness/field.json` notes say objectui's lookup reads `allow_create` / `lookup_columns` / `lookup_page_size`; objectui#12157 retires those reads
body:
Filing class: **① product defect**, a `finding` of class (c), reach by exception: **release text**. `@objectstack/spec` ships its `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so a false docblock there is published to every adopter and AI author who reads the schema. The liveness ledger is read by the dispatch seats as testimony.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#12157

- **Who acts:** objectstack's `domain:spec` seat, after triage grades it. The change is prose only: the docblock above the lookup picker keys in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, and three `note` strings in `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` (`lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize`, `allowCreate`).
- **When:** after objectstack's `.objectui-sha` covers the merge commit of objectui#12157's PR (objectstack-ai/objectui#12215). Until then the paragraph still describes the pinned console, which reads the aliases. The unlock is the pin, not the merge: check it with REST `compare` from that merge commit to the pin (the pin is `088e0f7` at filing).
- **Dedupe:** two objectstack issue searches, closed included. "SNAKE_CASE TOLERANCE docblock FieldSchema lookupColumns allowCreate snake alias stale" returned 1 hit, objectstack-ai/objectstack#4884 (closed, an unrelated schema-drift detector). "liveness field.json lookup_columns lookup_page_size allow_create note reads" returned 5 hits, all closed. The nearest is objectstack-ai/objectstack#15540 (closed), the same shape one round earlier: two `displayField` notes left crediting objectui with snake reads that objectui#7155 removed.
- **Found by:** triage's grade on objectui#12157 (`6112544498`, "Foreseen follow-up, filed at claim"). Filed at that card's ACCEPT by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat (objectstack-ai/objectui#10217), session `session_0149MdowTfyuWZuSSESLUYnE`.

## The reading (objectstack `main` `8e4a2302a`, objectui `main` after objectui#12157 lands)

- The docblock headed "SNAKE_CASE TOLERANCE — measured on the consumer, not assumed" says objectui's readers accept a snake_case alias for `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize` and `allowCreate`, "each read as `snake ?? camel` in LookupField.tsx", and calls them "the three aliases that survive". After objectui#12157, `LookupField` and `resolveActionParams` read the camelCase key alone. No alias survives for any of the seven picker keys.
- `liveness/field.json`: the `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize` and `allowCreate` notes each end "(reads X || x)". After objectui#12157 each reads only the camelCase key.

## The direction this seat suggests (triage decides)

Rewrite the paragraph to say all seven picker keys are read camelCase-only, and that objectui folds a stored snake spelling onto the declared key at ingestion (`normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys`). Drop the "(reads … || …)" tails from the three ledger notes. No schema change, no key change.

Dedupe words: SNAKE_CASE TOLERANCE docblock · lookupColumns allow_create alias stale · liveness field.json reads lookup_columns
